scope: Node geometry, actual static physics raycasts, passive tracer math and render-state failure handling. No browser images, real GPU compilation, reflection success-path image validation or FPS measurement.

tests.name: The rendered collision solids match actual laboratory physics transforms
The physical floor, roof and clear test volume use one metre-based datum
All qualities keep finite geometry and a bounded scene budget without reallocating meshes
Flow is passive advection of the given velocity and stops at zero physical time
Commanded pose display reads target position/quaternion without modifying simulation state
A single stable-direction studio shadow obeys profile cadence and quality changes
Failed indoor reflection capture restores renderer and foreign visibility state
Disposal releases owned GPU resources once and leaves shared arrow geometry untouched
